Occidental continues to be a member of One Mind at Work, an employer coalition dedicated to implementing a gold standard for workplace mental health by combating stigma, improving access to treatment and prevention services and fostering a psychologically safe culture.
In 2023, Occidental launched an enhanced mental health benefit through Lyra Health.
Lyra Health provides cost-free mental and emotional healthcare that is effective, convenient and personalized to all employees and their dependents.

Lyra Health professionals provide virtual or in-person support for a variety of mental health concerns including anxiety, depression, stress management, parenting challenges, relationship conflicts and sleep problems.
